---
title: "Example Analysis"
description: "A short example report. Replace it with your own."
---

This report shows the parts of an analysis page. Replace it with your own
report, and keep one `.qmd` file per report in this folder.

## Data

```{r}
#| label: data
dat <- read.csv(file.path("..", "data", "example.csv"))
summary(dat)
```

## Bootstrap Means

Seed every random draw, so that each render gives the same numbers and the
same figures.

```{r}
#| label: bootstrap
set.seed(2026)
boot_means <- replicate(200, mean(sample(dat$score, replace = TRUE)))
hist(boot_means, main = "Bootstrap means of score", xlab = "Mean score")
```

## Paper Figures

Save each figure for the paper in `figures/`, which git tracks and the site
publishes. A report runs from its own folder, so it writes there as
`file.path("..", "figures", ...)`.

```{r}
#| label: save-figure
dir.create(file.path("..", "figures"), showWarnings = FALSE)
png(file.path("..", "figures", "bootstrap-means.png"),
    width = 6, height = 4, units = "in", res = 300)
hist(boot_means, main = "Bootstrap means of score", xlab = "Mean score")
invisible(dev.off())
```
